newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Golden Island mulls sale of control.
newsitem.headline: Golden Island mulls sale of control.

text.p: Restaurant operator Golden Island (Holdings) Ltd said on Thursday its major shareholders were in talks to sell control of the company.

The company said an independent third party had approached its major shareholders about a proposed acquisition of the company shares "which may result in a change in control of the company and trigger a general offer."
It did not identify the shareholders.

"Preliminary negotiations on the terms of the proposal are in progress and no agreement has been reached," the statement said, adding the company would make further statements if there were any development of the proposal.
The company shares, which rose HK$0.24 or 16.9 percent on Wednesday, were unchanged at HK$1.66 in early trade.
